inicio.kicker: Selling with AI Program · course 4 of 5 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: From Zero to Your First Client: enter through the AI audit
inicio.lead: Building got easy. Trusting what was built did not. In eight lessons you pick your niche, run an AI audit with written authorization, set your price, build your list, call and ask permission, run the meeting, and deliver with monthly advisory.
inicio.capa_alt: A consultant and the owner of a distribution company review a one-page report at a table, with the warehouse in the background.
inicio.aulas_sub: In first-client order: choose your offer and niche, audit, set your price, prospect, call, meet, and deliver.

itens: People who already know how to build automations and AI agents, but haven't landed their first client yet.
People who have realized that selling "I'll build your robot" has become a price war.
People who want to get into companies through the diagnostic, with a clear scope and written authorization.

blocos.t: What you will be able to do
itens: Separate the offers that lose value from the ones that build up, and put together your portfolio of 4 offers.
Run an AI audit: authorization, inventory of apps and agents, risks, and a report with a 30-day plan.
Build your price table, your list of companies, and the cold call script that asks for permission.
Run the 15-minute meeting, deliver in the client's accounts, and follow a 30-day plan to your first client.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in Professional 2030
itens: Professional 2030 has four roles: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor, and Trainer. All four sell trust, not building.
This course uses the Auditor as the way in: the AI audit opens the company's door. Then comes the Consultant, with the plan and the follow-up.
Common base it uses: AI risks, scope with written authorization ("it is not a pentest, nor incident response, nor legal advice"), and the one-page report.
